historySemantics: firstCommitAt and latestCommitAt are dates from the currently retained Git history. They are not incorporation, launch, or retirement dates.

directory.name: CodeVetter
directory.description: AI code review platform — desktop-first, works offline.
directory.makerNote: I built CodeVetter to make reviewing AI-generated code rigorous without giving up a local-first workflow.

directory.name: HeyPace
directory.description: Local-only macOS voice agent that can understand what is on your screen.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a fast, privacy-first Mac assistant that could understand what is on my screen while keeping the work local.

directory.name: PostTrainLLM
directory.description: A local factory for training, evaluating, and running specialist language models.
directory.makerNote: I use PostTrainLLM to explore local model training and turn those experiments into repeatable recipes for specialist models.

directory.name: Site Health
directory.description: A local portfolio dashboard for domains, performance, search, and AI visibility evidence.
directory.makerNote: I built Site Health because I needed one clear view of Fleet’s domains, performance, search visibility, and AI visibility.

directory.name: Live
directory.description: The original Significant Hobbies experience, now independently owned while preserving its data and authentication boundary.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a product that helps people live more intentionally through goals, possibilities, and things worth anticipating.

directory.name: ChatGPT Connections
directory.description: A read-only MCP gateway that exposes selected public Fleet data to ChatGPT connections.
directory.makerNote: I had many projects but no solid way to connect them to ChatGPT, so I built a selective gateway for that.

directory.name: SaaS Maker
directory.description: Software as a specialized service: a living studio of focused products built for particular problems and maintained in public.
directory.makerNote: I use SaaS Maker as the public home for Fleet and as a workshop for reusable feedback, workflow, and automation tools.

directory.name: GitStat
directory.description: A GitHub analytics dashboard for contribution history, code churn, collaboration, and AI-assisted work.
directory.makerNote: I built GitStat to understand how my time and code churn are distributed across a large collection of repositories.

directory.name: Reel Pipeline
directory.description: A cost-bounded pipeline for planning, producing, and retaining short-form video artifacts.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to automate the repetitive work of making and publishing useful product videos.

directory.name: Mobile Dev Cockpit
directory.description: A parked mobile supervision client retained for possible future reactivation.
directory.makerNote: I explored whether development work running on a desktop could be supervised clearly from a phone.

directory.name: Drank
directory.description: Domain Rating intelligence for product, SEO, and market research.
directory.makerNote: I built DRank when domain-rating data became accessible enough to track the strength of my own domains over time.

directory.name: Email Manager
directory.description: A private Gmail workspace for local semantic search, sender insights, and explicit unsubscribe workflows.
directory.makerNote: Gmail did not help me see who was filling my inbox, so I built a clearer way to understand volume and unsubscribe.

directory.name: Memory Map
directory.description: Turn a ChatGPT export into a private, browser-computed map of recurring themes, facts, and conversations.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to learn what my exported AI conversations reveal about my themes, emotions, memory, and personal change.

directory.name: Free AI
directory.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway across free-tier model providers.
directory.makerNote: I built Free AI to make genuinely useful free model capacity easier to discover and use through one resilient interface.

directory.name: PSI Swarm
directory.description: Repeated Lighthouse distributions for honest website performance tracking.
directory.makerNote: I wanted repeatable evidence of how my products perform under real Lighthouse conditions, not a single flattering test.

directory.name: High Signal
directory.description: Evidence-backed daily intelligence across technology, startups, finance, and public markets.
directory.makerNote: I built High Signal to combine scattered news and data sources and extract the signals that are actually useful.

directory.name: EverythingRated
directory.description: A general-purpose rating and comparison experiment.
directory.makerNote: I have long wanted a place where people can make lists and rate anything, while recognizing that its social loop needs real care.

directory.name: Research Papers
directory.description: Academic paper discovery and a structured research data asset.
directory.makerNote: I wanted one large, searchable research library where retrieval could help me understand what already exists in a market.

directory.name: Materia
directory.description: Evidence-graded remedy reference organized by body system.
directory.makerNote: I want to make anatomy explorable and connect body concerns to clear, evidence-based information about treatments and remedies.

directory.name: Knowledge Base
directory.description: Private agent search over specialized corpora with ranked citations, provenance, and schema-aware retrieval.
directory.makerNote: I built Knowledge Base as the private, cited retrieval layer that other Fleet applications can rely on.

directory.name: Significant Hobbies
directory.description: The shared Hub and backend for six maintained Significant Hobbies applications, plus retained compatibility data domains.
directory.makerNote: I wanted one Hub for my maintained personal apps while letting every app keep ownership of its own data.

directory.name: India Standards
directory.description: A transparent India demographic standards calculator using aggregate PLFS data, explicit uncertainty ranges, and clear source limits.
directory.makerNote: I wanted official data to provide a more grounded answer to how a person is doing in the Indian context.

directory.name: Anime List
directory.description: Anime and manga discovery with multi-axis filtering and personal watchlists.
directory.makerNote: I wanted better anime filtering and discovery than the standard catalog experience, with a watchlist that works for me.

directory.name: Chess Coach
directory.description: Browser chess against Stockfish with optional AI move coaching.
directory.makerNote: I built Chess to explore whether a local AI agent could become a practical, patient partner for improving my game.

directory.name: LoopTV
directory.description: A lean-back, TV-style random video player for curated channels.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a more controlled and curated way to watch YouTube, shaped like television rather than an endless feed.

directory.name: Reader
directory.description: Capture, annotate, revisit, and discuss saved reading.
directory.makerNote: I wanted any article or PDF to become a focused reading and research surface instead of another forgotten browser tab.

directory.name: SWE Interview Prep
directory.description: A learning OS for software-engineering interview practice.
directory.makerNote: I built this as a learning-by-doing system that combines Pomodoro, Feynman, retrieval practice, and practical roadmaps.

directory.name: Calorie
directory.description: A private, local-first food, water, and weight journal with transparent timing guidance.
directory.makerNote: I wanted one personal system for weight loss that connects food logging, fasting, exercise timing, and daily performance.

directory.name: Setline
directory.description: An iOS-native training tracker that runs a written strength, cardio and mobility programme one set at a time and measures each exercise against an authored target.
directory.makerNote: I built Setline to make workouts easier to execute one set at a time, with timing and performance kept accurate.

directory.name: Journal
directory.description: A private daily journal and personal archive with an independently owned native codebase.
directory.makerNote: I believe journaling is an important habit, so I wanted a durable journal that fits naturally inside the Hub.

directory.name: Kith
directory.description: A private iPhone app for the people you actually want to stay close to — closeness-weighted constellation home, standing notes, and a chronological log per person.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a beautiful personal relationship-memory app that helps me stay more thoughtful about the people in my life.

directory.name: iOS landings
directory.description: Shared Astro factory that builds separate static sites for Significant Hobbies iOS apps.
directory.makerNote: I built one reusable landing-page engine so each native Significant Hobbies app does not need to reinvent its public home.

directory.name: RolePatch
directory.description: AI-assisted resume tailoring, role research, and interview preparation.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a focused way to tailor a resume and its supporting material to the actual job description.

directory.name: Karte
directory.description: An AI link-in-bio that turns a profile into a conversation.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a link-in-bio surface that could grow into something more personal: a greeting card, profile, and small agent.

directory.name: Starboard
directory.description: Organize and semantically search your GitHub stars.
directory.makerNote: GitHub Stars stopped working for me at scale, so I built a better personal interface for exploring what I had saved.

directory.name: AliveVille
directory.description: Persistent AI world and multi-agent simulation experiments.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to create a long-running world where AI characters remember, form grudges, make choices, and live through open-ended conflict.

directory.name: Protein Index
directory.description: Searchable protein and nutrition reference.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a clear catalog for comparing the protein products available in India, despite the difficulty of reliable data.

directory.name: Recipe Index
directory.description: A searchable directory of vegetarian protein foods and practical nutrition comparisons.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a practical collection of higher-protein recipes that works with ingredients people actually use in Indian kitchens.

directory.name: App Health
directory.description: Privacy-first endpoint health for Node, Go, and OpenTelemetry services.
directory.makerNote: I built App Health because checking Sentry, PostHog, Slack, and cloud consoles separately made basic product health too fragmented.

directory.name: Mashup
directory.description: A local-first tool that turns owned media archives into inspectable multi-clip edits.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a creator’s archive to become coherent topic-specific compilations instead of a pile of isolated clips.

directory.name: Motion
directory.description: Use your body as the controller for an iPhone-hosted game that can mirror to a larger screen.
directory.makerNote: I wanted body movement captured by a phone to become playful games on a television—and a workout without feeling like one.

directory.name: TrueHire
directory.description: Earlier resume and hiring workflow superseded by RolePatch.
directory.makerNote: I explored whether candidates could be ranked more transparently using verified evidence from their public GitHub work.

directory.name: Open Historia
directory.description: Interactive historical storytelling and world simulation.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a local, credit-free version of an AI grand-strategy game where long-form memory could make countries feel alive.

directory.name: Companion Robot
directory.description: Earlier companion robotics and embodied-agent exploration.
directory.makerNote: I am keeping this as a future exploration of what a genuinely useful embodied AI companion could become.

directory.name: Forecast Lab
directory.description: Forecasting experiments and evaluation tooling.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to learn forecasting by modeling how regional, temporal, and behavioral signals shape commerce demand.

directory.name: Web Playables
directory.description: Small browser-playable game experiments.
directory.makerNote: I built this laboratory to understand how idle and HTML-based games are designed, shipped, and distributed.

directory.name: What It Takes to Win
directory.description: Explore 2,585 documented early-breakthrough paths without pretending success follows a formula.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to study the real advantages behind success and replace unhelpful comparison with evidence-based understanding.

directory.name: Sarthak Agrawal
directory.description: Personal portfolio of Sarthak Agrawal — AI infrastructure and product engineer.
directory.makerNote: I maintain a personal website because I need one durable, accurate public record of my work and professional identity.

directory.name: Office OS
directory.description: A local-first Mac workplace where named AI employees have bounded responsibilities and their work stays inspectable.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to explore a company where humans and non-coding agents each own outcomes and keep working toward them over time.

directory.name: Local AI Video Studio
directory.description: A local-first Mac studio for comparing reproducible video-effect variants before export.
directory.makerNote: I wanted editing intent to choose efficient local video tools before defaulting to expensive generative video.

directory.name: Field Track
directory.description: A private field-location system for managed Android devices and team-scoped route review.
directory.makerNote: I started Field Track for my father: an employee-controlled way to share field location only when work requires it.

directory.name: Reddit Insights
directory.description: A bounded research collector for subreddit evidence and recurring insight snapshots.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to understand how the signals and emotions inside a subreddit change over time, even though historical data is difficult to obtain.

directory.name: Verified Bases
directory.description: A retained research-data identity with no retained local Git history or standalone public destination.
directory.makerNote: I explored whether the native codebases I already build could become inexpensive, verified templates for other makers.

directory.name: Anchor
directory.description: A local-first day planner and focus timer for Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch that explains the gap between the schedule you planned and the day you lived.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a realistic daily planner that could help me follow the day and explain why the lived plan diverged from the intended one.
